component.name: Omarchy Arcade
component.summary: Curated master game suite and offline retro desktop arcade

description.p: Omarchy Arcade is a curated suite of lightweight, native desktop arcade games built with Qt6, QML, and Python. Designed for offline personal computing, it features zero telemetry, zero advertisements, and zero network requirements.
Features tactile retro 3.5" floppy disk navigation, real-time desktop theme synchronization with Omarchy system palettes, and keyboard-first controls.
Curated suite of 39 native desktop retro arcade games featuring Featured discovery shelves, retro 3.5" floppy carousel, instant search, and zero bloat.
